task_completion.description: Navigate to the Odoo Calendar module.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screen shows the Odoo Calendar view (grid, day, week, or month view) with the 'Calendar' app name in the top left or breadcrumbs.

task_completion.description: Open the search/filter dropdown menu to access custom filters.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The search bar dropdown is expanded, showing options like 'Filters', 'Group By', and 'Favorites'.

task_completion.description: Configure a custom filter for the attendee 'Grace Patel'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Custom Filter' dialog or menu is visible where the field is set to 'Attendees' (or 'Attendees/Contact'), the operator is 'contains' or 'is', and the value is typed as 'Grace Patel'.

task_completion.description: Save the current search/filter with the specific name 'CFO Schedule'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save current search' input field under the 'Favorites' menu contains the text 'CFO Schedule'.

task_completion.description: Confirm the filter is successfully saved and appears in the Favorites list.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Favorites' section of the search dropdown now lists 'CFO Schedule' as a selectable option.

integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Odoo menus, dropdowns, and input fields.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application rather than jumping to a final state URL.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target filter name must be exactly 'CFO Schedule'. The filter must target the attendee 'Grace Patel'. Grace Patel is the CFO in this environment. The filter is created within the Odoo Calendar module and saved under the 'Favorites' section of the search bar.
